workItems.title: Bump Maven dependencies to Jakarta EE 10 coordinates
workItems.description:
Replace all legacy javax.* Maven coordinates with Jakarta EE 10 equivalents. Changes required:
1. REMOVE: javax:javaee-api:8.0.1 → ADD: jakarta.platform:jakarta.jakartaee-api:10.0.0 (provided)
2. REMOVE: javax.xml.bind:jaxb-api:2.3.1 → ADD: jakarta.xml.bind:jakarta.xml.bind-api:4.0.0 (provided)
3. REMOVE: org.glassfish.jaxb:jaxb-runtime:2.3.1 → ADD: org.glassfish.jaxb:jaxb-runtime:4.0.3 (runtime)
4. REMOVE: javax.xml.ws:jaxws-api:2.3.1 → ADD: jakarta.xml.ws:jakarta.xml.ws-api:4.0.0 (provided)
5. REMOVE: javax.jws:javax.jws-api:1.1 → (bundled in jaxws-api:4.0.0; no separate dep needed)
6. UPDATE: org.hibernate.validator:hibernate-validator:6.0.21.Final → 8.0.1.Final (Jakarta BV 3.0 compatible)
Also update Maven compiler source/target from 1.8 to 17.

workItems.title: Update Liberty server.xml feature names to Jakarta EE 10
workItems.description: Replace legacy Liberty feature 'javaee-8.0' with 'jakartaee-10.0' in server.xml <featureManager> block.
